purpose.zh: 轻轻打开胸口和肩膀前侧
purpose.en: Gently open your chest and the fronts of your shoulders.

text.zh: 手肘和手背贴地，双臂沿地面往头的方向滑
text.en: Keep elbows and hands on the floor and slide your arms toward your head

text.zh: 仰躺屈膝，双脚踩地，腰放松。
text.en: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, lower back relaxed.

text.zh: 有轻微拉伸感就停住，再慢慢滑回。
text.en: Stop at a mild stretch, then slide back down slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the arms off the floor and forcing it.

cautions.zh: 肩膀疼时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your shoulders hurt, reduce the range, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画 8 秒 1 次「上滑-停约 4.6 s-滑回」在重复，剂量从 30 秒保持改为 2 组×5 次（rep_hold）
英文名 Supine 改 Lying；顶点口令英文缩为 Breathe
主口令缩短；caution 改「X 时 Y」
